globalRules: Unknown tutorial or step IDs fail closed.
Predecessor seen/completed/dismissed history is preserved byte-for-byte; a shared tutorial never repeats when already resolved.
A segmented tutorial stores per-step history under its one existing tutorial ID and resumes at the next contextually eligible unseen step.
Skip and replay change tutorial or neutral UI state only; they never change facility, story, Family, reward, pupil, patient, or claim state.
Tutorials never block closing, resolving, claiming, offline passage, or passive production.
Canonical dot actor/facility IDs are used in runtime; legacy colon/shorthand IDs remain read-only aliases for predecessor history.
Speaker fallback is transparent cutout, approved frame, then text-only; unframed full-background profile art is forbidden.
Every tutorial remains usable at 320 by 568, 390 by 844, keyboard-only input, reduced motion, and 30 percent text expansion.
